study type: retrospective analysis of prospectively collected data
cohort: 13,987 very low birth weight infants with a birthweight of 500-1500 g and 23-35 weeks of gestation born at NEOCOSUR Neonatal Network centers from January 1, 2001, through December 31, 2016
finding: Progress in perinatal and neonatal care at network centers was associated with an improvement in survival without major morbidity of very low birth weight infants during a 16-year period, however overall mortality remained unchanged.
